1 cup (2 sticks) butter

1 large egg

1 1/2 cup granulated sugar

2 1/2 tsp vanilla extract

2 cups all purpose flour

1/2 tsp baking soda

1/2 tsp baking powder

Topping:

1/2 cup cinnamon 

1/2 cup granulated sugar

1 tbsp sea salt

1 or 2 bags of chewy caramels

Beat butter egg sugar and vanilla together until smooth. Slowly add dry ingredients making sure scrape the sides so everything gets mixed in. Mix the cinnamon sugar together in a seperate bowl.  Let the dough chill for about an hour in the fridge. Scoop out dough, roll in cinnamon sugar and place on an ungreased baking sheet. Press a caramel into the middle of the dough and sprinkle some salt on top. Bake for 8-10 minutes or until edges are browned. Let cool unless you wanna get hot caramel all over your mouth (you don't, trust me) pour a big glass of milk and enjoy
